venues.note: Cosmic 'Galactic' night tubing — lights and music on a 42-lane tube park (self-billed largest in the USA). Made-for-dates winter activity (per camelbackresort.com). 4.4★ (359).
venues.seasonText: Winter season 2026–27, Dec–Mar (conditions permitting); Christmas week included
venues.priceDetail: $49–$69 per 2-hour session

venues.name: Lehigh Gorge Scenic Railway
venues.hours: Daily departures 11am, 1pm, 3pm (weekends +4:30pm in season) · Autumn Leaf schedule Sep 26–Nov 15
venues.note: The only established scenic train ride in NEPA — a 70-minute round trip through the gorge (45 min during Autumn Leaf season), and the open-air car is the photographer's pick. Pairs perfectly with a Jim Thorpe afternoon: Asa Packer Mansion + the Old Jail. Adult $22–39 depending on season/class.
venues.seasonText: Regular season + Autumn Leaf 2026: Sep 26–Nov 15 (45-min foliage rides; holiday trains late Nov–Dec)
venues.priceDetail: Adult $22–39 depending on season/class; daily departures 11am, 1pm, 3pm (weekends +4:30pm in season)

venues.name: Houdini Museum
venues.hours: Year-round · Weekends ~1–4:30pm (daily afternoons Jul–Aug) · Call for tour dates/times
venues.note: A guided tour of Houdini memorabilia in a 150-year-old house, capped by a live magic show with doves, ducks, and a floating finale. Adult admission $39.95 (VIP front row +$10); long-running Scranton attraction with 178+ reviews.
venues.priceDetail: Adult $39.95; child (4–11) $29.95; VIP front row +$10/person. Hours vary by day — call ahead for tour times.

venues.name: Lackawanna Coal Mine Tour
venues.hours: Thu–Mon · Tours hourly 10:45am–2:30pm (arrive 30 min early) · Apr 1–Nov 30, 2026 · $12 adult
venues.note: Descend 300 feet in a mine car for an hour-long tour led by former miners — bring a jacket (53°F year-round). Easy combo with the PA Anthracite Heritage Museum next door in the same McDade Park complex. National-Award-winning, county-run, mentioned on NBC's The Office.
venues.priceDetail: Adult $12; senior 65+ $10; military $10; children 12 & under $9 (tours hourly 10:45am–2:30pm; arrive 30 min early)

venues.name: No. 9 Coal Mine & Museum
venues.hours: Wed–Sun 10am–4pm · Tours on the hour (~1 hour) · Mine always 50°F
venues.note: Ride a loud, rattly coal car 200 feet into the mountain — miners' hospital, big mining machinery, and guides who put their own spin on the tour. ~$10 adult per recent reviews; historic anthracite mine, 4.7★ (336).
venues.flag: Cash only — call ahead.
venues.priceDetail: Adult ~$10; cash only — call ahead

venues.name: Electric City Trolley Museum
venues.note: Ride a vintage trolley through the Lackawanna Valley — departs from the Steamtown boarding platform, so it's an easy double-stop with the free railroad site. Museum $9 adult, ride $12, combo $15. (Weekends in Nov–Dec run the Santa on the Trolley series.)
venues.seasonText: Museum daily Apr–Dec 2026; excursions Thu–Sun Apr 9–Oct 25, 2026 (departures 10:30am/12pm/1:30pm/3pm)
venues.priceDetail: Museum $9; trolley ride $12; combo $15 adult

venues.name: Steamtown National Historic Site
venues.hours: Daily ~9:30am–5pm · FREE grounds & museums · Short train rides Fri–Sun May–Oct (extra fee)
venues.note: A free National Park with vintage locomotives, the roundhouse, and ranger talks — ride a nearly 100-year-old train into downtown Scranton. Train rides extra (~$6 adult). 4.6★ (933).
venues.priceDetail: Free grounds & museums; short train rides ~$6 extra (Fri–Sun, May–Oct)

venues.name: Everhart Museum
venues.note: Bird gallery with 700+ specimens, a fossil gallery with a Stegosaurus cast, fluorescent 'glow-in-the-dark' minerals, and African and Egyptian collections. The largest public museum in NEPA, founded 1908. Adult $10 (2026 museum-directory listing). 4.4★ (259).
venues.priceDetail: Adult $10; 60+ $5; students $3; kids 12 & under free (museum-directory 2026 listing)

venues.name: Asa Packer Mansion
venues.addr: Packer Hill Ave, Jim Thorpe, PA 18229
venues.hours: Grounds 11am–4:15pm · Guided tours 11:30am–3:30pm (~45–60 min) · Apr–Dec (Memorial Day–Oct 31: 6 days/wk, closed Tue; Nov: Sat/Sun) · $20 general
venues.note: The best-preserved Italianate villa in the US (completed 1861) with original Victorian furnishings — tours run since 1956 by the Jim Thorpe Lions Club and the house is a National Historic Landmark. No photos inside; the entrance is a steep climb. 4.6★ (678).
venues.seasonText: Apr–Dec 2026 (Memorial Day–Oct 31: 6 days/wk, closed Tue; Nov: Sat/Sun; Dec: first 2 weekends)
venues.priceDetail: General (19–54) $20; senior 55+ $18; student (6–18) $15; 5 & under $10 (guided tours 11:30am–3:30pm)

venues.name: Old Jail Museum
venues.hours: Daily 12–4pm · Closed Wednesday · ~45-min guided tours + self-guided rooms · Adult $12
venues.note: The 1871 stone-fortress jail with 27 original cells, a recreated gallows, and the famous Cell 17 handprint that supposedly can't be washed off. Adult $12 (2026-listed). 4.0★ (589 TripAdvisor reviews).
venues.flag: Check the current schedule before going.
venues.seasonText: Memorial Day–fall (check schedule — older sources list Memorial Day–Labor Day + Sept/Oct weekends; 2026 reviews suggest wider operation)
venues.priceDetail: Adult $12 (2026-listed)

venues.name: Eckley Miners' Village
venues.hours: Museum & visitor center Wed–Sun 10am–4pm · Guided tours 11am & 2pm (don't miss them)
venues.note: Walk an intact 19th-century company town — miners' double houses, two churches, and the Company Store built for the Molly Maguires movie. $8 museum + self-guided village, $10 with the guided tour. The largest best-preserved anthracite community in the US; a PA Historical & Museum Commission site. 4.6★ (280).
venues.priceDetail: Adult $8 museum + self-guided village; $10 with guided tour; youth $6 (guided tours 11am & 2pm)

venues.name: Quiet Valley Living Historical Farm
venues.hours: Summer season tours: Tue–Sat 10am–5pm · $15 adult ($18 events) · 52nd Annual Harvest Festival Oct 10–11
venues.note: An 1800s Pennsylvania German homestead with costumed interpreters — hearth cooking, spinning, bake-oven bread on Saturdays, wagon rides to the heritage orchard. Operating since ~1974; summer season ends early September, with the Harvest Festival (Oct 10–11, 2026) and a Spooky Days evening murder mystery (Oct 23–24, 6–8:30pm) to close the year.
venues.seasonText: Summer tours Jun 20–Sep 7, 2026 (ended); Harvest Festival Oct 10–11; Spooky Days Oct 23–24
venues.priceDetail: Adult $15; ages 3–12 $8 (summer season; event pricing $18). Note: regular summer season has ended — Sun by appointment

venues.name: Bushkill Falls
venues.hours: Daily ~9am–4pm/5pm · Spring through late fall · Adult ~$22 / seniors (62+) ~$20 / kids 4–10 ~$12 / 3 & under free
venues.note: 'The Niagara of Pennsylvania' — eight waterfalls linked by bridges and boardwalks. Green Trail is an easy 15 minutes; the Red Trail runs ~2 miles with 1,200+ stairs for the full adventure. Not wheelchair/stroller friendly; pets on leash allowed. Welcoming visitors since 1904. 4.6★ (3,772).
venues.priceDetail: Adult $22; senior 62+ $20; kids 4–10 $12; 3 & under free

venues.name: Claws 'N' Paws Wild Animal Park
venues.hours: Daily 10am–6pm · May through mid-October · Adult $24 / juniors (2–11) $16 / under 2 free
venues.note: 'The zoo in the woods' — 120+ species along shaded trails, with keeper-led encounters through the day and giraffe feeding ($3) as the crowd favorite. 4.1★ (445).
venues.priceDetail: Adult $24; juniors (2–11) $16; seniors ~$18; under 2 free

venues.name: Pocono Snake & Animal Farm
venues.addr: 424 Seven Bridge Rd, East Stroudsburg, PA 18301
venues.hours: Memorial Day–Columbus Day: daily 11am–5pm · Summer daily 11am–5pm · Winter: pleasant-weather weekends only · $13 adult / kids 2–11 $10
venues.note: Celebrating its 57th year — hand-feed monkeys, lemurs, a bear, 'gators (summer) and a pot-bellied pig. A compact ~40-minute visit and an easygoing afternoon stop. USDA/PAGC approved. 4.8★ (176).
venues.seasonText: Memorial Day–Columbus Day daily 11am–5pm; shoulder-season hours vary (12–5/12–4:30); winter: pleasant-weather weekends only
venues.priceDetail: Adult $13; kids 2–11 $10; under 2 free

venues.name: The Cabin Armory & Training Center
venues.note: Indoor range with electronic target retrieval, rental firearms, and beginner-friendly instruction — walk-ins welcome, no membership needed.
venues.priceDetail: $20/hr walk-in lane rental ($10 second shooter same lane); 30-day unlimited $45

venues.name: PA State Game Lands Public Shooting Ranges
venues.hours: Mon–Sat 8am–sunset · Sun 12pm–sunset · open year-round unless posted
venues.note: Free outdoor public rifle and pistol ranges run by the PA Game Commission — bring your own ammo and targets; no range officer on site. Daytime only, 8am to sunset. Requires a PA hunting/furtaker license or the ~$32/year PGC range permit (plus ID). Nearest range to Kingston is off Patla Rd, Ross Township; another serves the Scranton area off Salem Mt. Rd, Archbald.
venues.priceDetail: Free to shoot; PA hunting license or ~$32/yr PGC range permit required

venues.name: Revolution Ice Centre
venues.note: Year-round two-rink ice arena with public skating, cosmic glow skate nights, hockey and learn-to-skate programs. Public-skate session times change by day — check the day's schedule before heading over.
venues.priceDetail: Public skate ~$8 + $3 skate rental

venues.name: River Grille
venues.addr: 670 N River St Ste 100, Wilkes-Barre, PA 18702
venues.note: Riverside bar & grill with live music, trivia nights, themed pop-up bars, and weekend brunch from 11am.
venues.priceDetail: $$ American bar & grill; weekend brunch from 11am

venues.name: On&On
venues.note: Two-floor vintage marketplace with 60+ local vendors — mid-century housewares, vintage clothing, and a big vinyl record selection. Famous Dwight Schrute mural on the building.
venues.priceDetail: Free to browse; 60+ local vintage/antique vendors

venues.name: Viewmont Mall
venues.note: The Scranton area's main enclosed mall — 70+ stores, food court, and a Regal cinema on site.
venues.priceDetail: Free entry; Boscov's, JCPenney, Dick's Sporting Goods + Regal cinema

venues.name: Wyoming Valley Mall
venues.note: Regional mall just off I-81 with 50+ stores and a food court; individual store hours may vary from mall hours.
venues.priceDetail: Free entry; JCPenney, Macy's, Bath & Body Works, Hot Topic

venues.name: Laurel Mall
venues.note: Family mall in Hazle Township with national anchors, a food court, and a kids' play area.
venues.priceDetail: Free entry; Boscov's, Hobby Lobby + Regal cinema

venues.name: Jack & Jill's Billiards
venues.note: Long-running basement pool hall with a dive-bar feel — very affordable table time, a classic late-night hangout for groups.
venues.priceDetail: Inexpensive table time (Google price level $)

venues.name: Eagle Billiards
venues.addr: 873 Scranton Carbondale Hwy, Dickson City, PA
venues.note: 10 regulation Brunswick tables plus 3 Diamonds, with arcade games, darts, and a full bar.
venues.priceDetail: Table time + drinks ~$15–25 pp (estimated)

venues.name: Splinters' Hatchet & Axe Throwing
venues.note: 13 WATL axe-throwing lanes, BYOB — reviewers call it a date-night pick.
venues.priceDetail: Per-person sessions, moderate (estimated)

venues.name: Jim Mc Carthy Tavern On Hill
venues.note: Family-run Irish tavern for 40+ years — one of NEPA's original karaoke bars, with open-mic nights and in-house dart leagues.
venues.priceDetail: Inexpensive drinks (Google price level: inexpensive)

venues.name: The V Spot Bar
venues.note: Non-smoking bar with live music four nights a week — Sunday karaoke, Monday DJ, Tuesday open mic, Wednesday line dancing.
venues.priceDetail: Moderate pub fare + drinks (Google price level: moderate)

venues.name: Groove Brewing
venues.hours: Wed–Thu 5–9pm · Fri 3–9pm · Sat 12–9pm · Sun 12–8pm · Mon–Tue closed
venues.note: Neighborhood taproom with rotating craft taps, live music, trivia, and food trucks outside — no kitchen, outside food welcome.
venues.priceDetail: Inexpensive pints (Google price level: inexpensive)

venues.name: O'Malley's Tavern
venues.note: Family-run Irish tavern since 1964 — Tuesday karaoke with DJ Lucas packs the house, Wednesday open mic.
venues.priceDetail: Inexpensive drinks (estimated)

venues.name: Dunn's Tavern
venues.note: Non-smoking dive bar with shuffleboard, a pool table, and dart boards.
venues.priceDetail: Cheap drinks (estimated)

venues.name: 940 Golf N' Fun
venues.note: Mini golf, arcade, batting cages, and bumper cars — open till 11pm nightly through the season.
venues.priceDetail: Pay per attraction, moderate (estimated)

venues.name: Valley Bowling Lanes
venues.hours: Cosmic bowling Fri & Sat 8pm–1am · UNREAL AR-projection lanes · Open bowl daily (Fri 3pm–1am · Sat 9am–1am · Sun 12pm–11:30pm · Mon 3pm–11:30pm · Tue–Thu 12pm–11:30pm)
venues.note: UNREAL AR-projection bowling on 8 lanes — interactive lane graphics and ball-tracking effects — plus Fri & Sat cosmic from 8pm with a DJ taking requests. Full bar (Champions Lounge), arcade, and pool tables.
venues.priceDetail: Open play ~$5.75/game or $34.95/lane/hr; cosmic $6/game or $37.95/hr (+$50 to add UNREAL to a party)
